payload.detail: BLOCKED 2026-09-19, and the blocker is network policy rather than code. The egress proxy answers 403 to cdn.playwright.dev, verified directly: npx playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell firefox webkit failed on every download. /opt/pw-browsers holds chromium-1194 while node_modules/playwright-core/browsers.json pins 1243, so scripts/playwright-browser-preflight.mjs refuses before the build by design, and docs/testing.md forbids working around a revision mismatch. Firefox and WebKit are absent entirely. TO UNBLOCK: run from an environment whose egress allows cdn.playwright.dev, or have an operator pre-seed /opt/pw-browsers with revision 1243 plus firefox and webkit. Owner chose reproduce-then-fix-only-if-the-trace-shows-it, so nothing was guessed. Line drift recorded: the test is tests/ui-tools.spec.ts:2952 today, not :2928. Both arms use a 30s waitForURL with no intermediate settle signal, which matches the unhydrated-link diagnosis. The destination skeleton exists and is referenced by no spec: src/app/(search-app)/differentials/presentations/[slug]/loading.tsx:5 renders role=status aria-label='Loading presentation'. Worth knowing: this same test is one of the 15 Firefox/WebKit failures in #9Z197J, so fixing those may resolve it.
